jobs.name: hammer_curl_a
jobs.motion: She performs slow controlled dumbbell hammer curls: palms face each other the whole time with a neutral grip and thumbs pointing up, her wrists never rotate, she curls both dumbbells up towards her shoulders keeping her elbows pinned at her sides, then lowers them until her arms are straight, upper arms stay still, smooth repetitions.

jobs.name: standing_calf_raise_a
jobs.motion: She performs slow controlled standing calf raises: standing on the low step platform holding a dumbbell in each hand at her sides, both feet stay side by side, both legs stay straight, she rises high onto the balls of both feet, pauses at the top, then slowly lowers her heels back down, her feet never leave the step, no swinging, smooth repetitions.

jobs.name: overhead_triceps_extension_a
jobs.motion: She performs slow controlled overhead triceps extensions: holding a dumbbell in each hand above her head, her upper arms stay vertical next to her ears and do not move, she bends only her elbows to lower both dumbbells behind her head, then extends her arms straight up again, torso upright, smooth repetitions.

jobs.name: reverse_fly_a
jobs.motion: She performs slow controlled bent-over dumbbell reverse flyes: torso hinged forward with a flat back, slight bend in the elbows, she raises both dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height squeezing her shoulder blades together, then lowers them slowly, her torso stays still, smooth repetitions.

jobs.name: russian_twist_a
jobs.motion: She performs controlled russian twists: sitting with her torso leaning back at about 45 degrees with a straight back, knees bent and heels on the floor, holding a weight plate with both hands, she rotates her torso from side to side bringing the plate beside each hip, smooth repetitions.
